svg.title: quercus-convexa-beaverhead-133496 - original atlas schematic
svg.desc: Original educational schematic; not a photograph or exact reconstruction. Original detached lobed oak-like leaf schematic, not a scan of the Christensen Ranch florule, a whole tree, an acorn or a species-level diagnosis of Q. convexa. The broad Oligocene-Miocene age envelope does not establish presence at exactly 20 Ma.
